raw.rationale: Skin biopsy showing intravascular atypical cells is a key diagnostic feature of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, which explains the patient's skin eruption and systemic symptoms such as fever and hypotension.

rejected.label: Pembrolizumab-associated cutaneous adverse reaction
rejected.why: The new skin eruption is described as different from the previous reaction to pembrolizumab, and the presence of intravascular atypical cells on skin biopsy is not typical of a cutaneous adverse reaction.

rejected.label: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma
rejected.why: There is no mention of HTLV-1 infection or other characteristic features of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, such as hypercalcemia or lytic bone lesions.

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
rejected.why: This condition typically involves the lungs and is associated with Epstein-Barr virus infection, which is not mentioned in the case.

rejected.label: Post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder
rejected.why: There is no mention of a transplant history, which is a prerequisite for this diagnosis.
